commands.name: open-paths
commands.description: open-paths: click a path, the file opens in its app (/open-paths help)
commands.output:
open-paths: mode inline · editor vscode · folders files · tool rows write · toast on
overrides: none

Commands:
  /open-paths                           this report
  /open-paths mode inline|auto|below|off  links in the reply; auto keeps another mod's drawing and adds a row; below always a row; off
  /open-paths editor <name|App Name>    vscode, cursor, zed, sublime, idea, default, or any app
  /open-paths set <ext> <target>        target: editor, default, reveal, or an app name
  /open-paths unset <ext>               back to the built-in rule for that type
  /open-paths folders files|editor      folders open in the file manager or the editor
  /open-paths tools write|all|off       an open line under Write, or Read/Write/Edit, tool rows
  /open-paths toast on|off              say what is opening
  /open-paths reset                     every setting back to its default

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
/open-paths → open-paths: mode inline · editor vscode · folders files · tool rows write · toas…

notes: ./register.tsx hooks: session.start, command.run{command=open-paths}, tool.call, ui.render{component=AssistantMessage}, ui.render{component=ToolUse}

./register.tsx calls: $.clock.after (via statOf), $.clock.now (via lookUp), $.command.register, $.fs.stat (via statOf), $.process.run (via platformOf, run), $.session.cwd (via ctxOf, platformOf), $.store.get, $.store.set, $.ui.invalidate, $.ui.resolve, $.ui.toast (via openHref, run)
